title_en: Amendment (X) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
For the purpose of punishing the criminal acts of insulting the national anthem, effectively maintaining the seriousness and national dignity of the playing and singing of the national anthem, one paragraph is added as paragraph 2 to Article 299 of the Criminal Law, and that Article is revised as follows:
"Whoever, in a public place, intentionally insults the National Flag or the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China by burning, damaging, defacing, smearing, trampling, or in other ways, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights.
"Whoever, in a public place, intentionally alters the lyrics or musical score of the National Anthem of the People's Republic of China, plays or sings the national anthem in a distorted or derogatory manner, or insults the national anthem in other ways, if the circumstances are serious, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."
This Amendment shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
